quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (2025 annual report) on aluminum electrolytic capacitors: full-chain upgrades - materials R&D on higher etched-foil specific capacitance, thickened etched foil, energy-saving formed foil, laminated foil, N-type conductive polymer and atomic-layer-deposition titanium-coated foil, with high-voltage formed-foil self-sufficiency at about 75%; manufacturing - trial production of high-voltage large-capacitance products, automation and digitalisation of Screw and Snap-in lines, a small-product model workshop in operation, technical upgrades of solid-liquid hybrid and MLPC products, and the design tender for a new manufacturing base completed; markets - held automation and consumer-electronics markets, caught the photovoltaic recovery after destocking and growth in on-board chargers and charging piles, and 'took a solid step' in the booming server-power and data-center market.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (2025 annual report) on film capacitors: competition in new energy and EVs was fierce, and small capacity, a narrow product range, limited upstream cost-down room and rising metal prices left revenue and profit below expectations; technically difficult products such as three-phase AC film capacitors achieved breakthroughs, with progress in upstream supply-chain cooperation and new-energy customer development.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (2025 annual report) on supercapacitors: fast growth in grid energy storage (frequency regulation, SVG) and automotive electronics; new products developed for new applications such as server power supplies passed broad trial certification and have batch orders; capacity utilisation has stayed high, and technical-upgrade expansion has begun to meet large-scale demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (2025 annual report): supercapacitors, especially lithium-ion supercapacitors (LIC), are recognised by well-known companies at home and abroad and are in batch use in rail transit, automotive, medical instruments, new energy, power grids, smart meters, AGVs and port machinery; generation-side and user-side frequency regulation and large-equipment power compensation are in substantive trial operation, and the application prospects in server power supplies are 'promising'. Film capacitors have started batch deliveries in new energy, EVs and defense - 'the performance inflection point has formed' and they are entering rapid growth. Solid multilayer polymer (MLPC), solid and solid-liquid hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors are among the key components of server power supplies, and N-type conductive polymer with new processes and materials brought a major performance breakthrough. The acquired Hitachi AIC turned profitable in its first year and has grown every year. Taking 2025 as year one, the company hopes to keep growing rapidly over the next three to five years and become one of the influential backbone companies of the global capacitor industry.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The 2016 raised-fund projects - the supercapacitor industrialisation project and the high-voltage large-capacity film capacitor expansion project - reached usable status on October 31, 2024 and both missed their expected returns: supercapacitors because market and customer development was slower than expected, the property slump cut demand and competition was fierce; film capacitors because customer qualification cycles were long and uncertain and price cuts left revenue and profit below plan. The company says the rise of data centers and other emerging applications brings an important development opportunity; all raised-fund projects were closed by end-2025.
